_help: Messages shown inside the Radio Velvet app (version 2.3.5 and later), one per app start. Fields: id (unique; change it to show a note again), to (web = website app, play = Google Play app, all), times (how many times each person sees it), until (last day, yyyy-mm-dd, optional), title, text (blank line = new paragraph), button + link (optional; a link 'whatsapp:<message>' opens a WhatsApp chat with Ranjith with that message typed in), sayTimes (true adds 'This note is shown only N times').

notes.title: Radio Velvet on Google Play
notes.text:
Radio Velvet is now being tested on Google Play, where it updates by itself like any other app.

Would you like to join the test? Send me a message on WhatsApp with the Gmail address on your phone and I'll add you.
